column1: # Evidence that cannot be read from a source marker, one row per function.
# Empty until a comparison, a move or a rejection is recorded: the ledger never
# claims a peer or a state it has no evidence for.
# address: the exe entry point; backend: 1 when a Diff case passed against the backend peer;
# failure_class: one of real, float-only, uninitialised read, hang, fault (empty when accepted);
# by_address_callers: number of callers that still reach the function by address.
